description: a young goddess of the night sky, a slender young woman with light warm skin, long straight black hair in a high ponytail hanging down her back at rest, lying flat on the back, not flying and not sticking out, a pretty young woman's face lit by soft silver light, a slim silver circlet, simple elegant armour of deep midnight indigo with silver edges shaped for a woman, a long indigo cape lined with silver hanging behind from the shoulders, indigo greaves and boots with silver edges, no crescent moon, no star, no bow and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the ponytail to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look in detail: face, hair, circlet, armour, cape and colours; the hands empty, without the crescent moon, the star and the bow
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
